Translate.Title: Libris Holdings
Translate.Intro: For the current view of bibliographic records (print), the corresponding holdings from Libris are displayed.
Translate.notitlesinfo: Search title/titles to see Libris Holdings.
Translate.noconfiginfo: App not configured properly, please contact your administrator.
Translate.notitlefound: No match for the ID from the Alma record
Translate.noholdingsfound: No holdings were found for the configured sigels
Translate.nonetworknumberfound: No Libris ID found in Alma record.
Translate.holding_deleteconfirm: {{count}} holding(s) for {{library}} will be deleted from Libris. This cannot be undone.
Translate.holding_saved: The holding was updated in Libris.
Translate.holding_deleted: The holding was deleted in Libris.
Translate.holding_conflict: The holding has been changed by someone else. Reload the view and try again.
Translate.holding_otherinfonote: Other holdings info cannot be edited here.
Translate.holding_deleterowconfirm: Do you want to delete this holding? The library's other holdings are kept. This cannot be undone.
Translate.holding_rowdeleted: The holding was deleted in Libris.
Translate.holding_added: The holding was added in Libris.
Translate.holding_created: The holding was created in Libris.
Translate.alma_nothing: No holdings were found in Alma for this library. Nothing needs to be deleted there.
Translate.alma_introall: The holding is deleted in Libris. Do you want to delete the library's holdings and items in Alma too? This will be deleted:
Translate.alma_introrows: The row is deleted in Libris. These items in Alma have the same call number. Clear the ones to keep:
Translate.alma_nomatch: No item in Alma has the same call number as the deleted row. Select the items to delete, if any:
Translate.alma_warning: Deleting in Alma cannot be undone. Items that are on loan, requested or in process cannot be deleted and are reported afterwards. The bib record is kept.
Translate.history_hint: Records where you deleted holdings. The record is still in Alma but not shown in Alma's search for titles with inventory. Copy the MMS ID and search with the scope All titles, or show the record here.
Translate.undo_librisall: The library's holding is created again with the same content. It gets a new id in Libris.
Translate.undo_librisrow: The row is put back in the holding at its old position.
Translate.undo_nothing: There is no saved information to undo this deletion.
Translate.undo_note: This recreates the records. They get new ids, and anything that belonged to the old records is not restored.
Translate.undo_gone: The holding no longer exists in Libris or has changed, so the row could not be put back.
Translate.undo_almaintro: Holdings and items are created again with the same data (barcode, call number, location). They get new ids, and loan history and anything else that belonged to the old records is not restored. If an item's barcode already exists, an error is shown.
Translate.alma_snapshotfailed: Could not save a copy of the records for undo, so nothing was deleted in Alma:
Translate.holding_alma_checkfailed: Could not check Alma in advance.
Translate.holding_alma_warning: Warning: Alma has items that cannot be deleted there
Translate.holding_alma_warningnote: You can still delete in Libris, but they will remain in Alma. Resolve them in Alma first if they should be removed.
Translate.holding_alma_r_notinplace: not in place (on loan or in process)
